title: traitor config
description: A repo's traitor settings, in .agents/traitor.json. Run `traitor init` to create or upgrade it.

$schema.description: The schema for the traitor version this config is for. `traitor init` reads the version from it and keeps it current.

traits.description: Settings for each trait, by the name of its folder in .agents/traits.

threshold.description: The probability of a fail at or above which this trait fails the check. Without one, the trait's verdicts are only reported.

exempt.description: Paths this trait doesn't judge, each group with its reason.

paths.description: Globs relative to the repo root, where * stops at a slash and ** crosses them.

reason.description: Why these paths don't have to hold the trait.
